# issue 4710 -- per-release matrix, repro + controls on the SAME binary
#
# predicate: triage.matches(4710, ...) over match.json, i.e. the literal text
#            'error: Index for resource array inside cbuffer must be a literal expression'
# command:   dxc -T ps_6_0 -E psMain <shader>
# generator: measure-history.py (committed beside this file)
#
# 'match' means DXC emitted the diagnostic the issue is about.
# Prereleases are excluded by policy: the issue names 'main' and the July 2022
# official release, not a prerelease.
#
# Rows marked 'subject' carry a history of their own and no expectation is
# asserted for them. Rows marked '[control OK]' are assertions: a build where a
# control misbehaves has not measured this issue and would be disqualified.
